name: Dash Field
description: Short double-lined dashes in a mixed ink palette, scattered edge to edge like a loose confetti of line segments.

code.style: --rule: ( border-style: double; border-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); border-width: @pick(3px 0 0 0, 0 3px 0 0, 0 0 3px 0, 0 0 0 3px); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; @size: 50%; border-style: double; border-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); border-width: @pick(3px 0 0 0, 0 3px 0 0, 0 0 3px 0, 0 0 0 3px); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
